concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-payment-methods]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms per-store ecommerce/POS payment-method and variant catalog with method-specific country, currency, approval, parameter and payment-facilitator notes; listed support is not store activation.
